info.accent: Used for badges, links, and focus outlines. Keep it distinct from your button color.
info.sale: Used for sale prices and sale badges only, so it keeps its meaning if you change the accent. Keep it at least 4.5:1 against the background.
info.border: Hairlines between cards and rows. Decorative only, so it can be subtle.
info.border_control: Outlines around inputs, size buttons, and other controls. Keep this at least 3:1 against the background so it stays visible.
info.corner_style: Applies to cards, inputs, and images across the theme.
info.density: Controls the space between and inside sections.
info.eyebrow_font: The small uppercase label shown above headings.
info.favicon: Shown in the browser tab. Use a square image, at least 180 x 180 px.
info.heading_scale: Scales every heading relative to the body size.
info.media_ratio: Portrait suits apparel. Natural keeps each image's own shape.
info.motion_reduced: Motion is turned off automatically for visitors who ask their device to reduce it.
info.motion_reveal: Sections fade in as they enter the viewport.
info.show_preorder_badge: Shown on products that are available to preorder.
info.show_quick_add: Lets customers add a product to the cart without leaving the collection.
info.show_second_image: Shows the next product image when a customer hovers the card.
info.show_vendor: Useful for stores that carry multiple brands.
info.social_link: Paste the full link, including https://
info.text_muted: Used for prices, captions, and helper text. Keep it at least 4.5:1 against the background.
info.sticky_header: The header stays at the top of the screen as customers scroll.
info.show_gift_note: Lets customers add a message to their order. Useful for stores that ship a lot of gifts.
info.show_accelerated_checkout: Shows Shop Pay, Apple Pay, and Google Pay in the cart. Turning this off will lower mobile conversion.
info.show_preorder_note: Tells customers when a preordered item ships.
info.sticky_atc: A compact buy bar appears at the bottom of the screen once the main button scrolls away.
info.show_size_guide: Shows a size chart next to the size options, pulled from the product or its brand.
info.show_filters: Filters come from the Search & Discovery app. Set them up in your admin under Search & Discovery > Filters.
info.brand_source: Automatic lists every brand you carry. Manual lets you pick and add a photo for each one.
info.brand_collection: Limits the list to brands in this collection. Leave empty to list every brand in the store.
info.filter_key: The filter your store uses for size. Find it in Search & Discovery > Filters.
info.filter_value: Only needed when the filter value differs from the label, for example 2T versus 2-toddler.
info.image_mobile: Used on phones. Leave empty to use the main image.
info.overlay: Darkens the image behind the text so it stays readable.
info.size_collection: Sizes link into this collection. Leave empty to search all products.
